newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy's Finmeccanica sees debt falling.
newsitem.headline: Italy's Finmeccanica sees debt falling.

text.p: Italian state controlled engineering company Finmeccanica expects to reduce its group net financial debt to 5.4 trillion lire by the end of the year from 5.967 trillion reported at the end of June, it said in a statement said.
Finmeccanica said it was also in negotiations on the domestic market for a medium-long term revolving credit operation of around 3.0 trillion to be used to pay back short term debts.
Finmeccanica confirmed that income from divestments of non-core activities should reach 1.0 trillion lire this year, compared with 387 billion on June 30 this year.
The company is Italy's largest defence and aerospace group and is controlled by state industrial holding Iri.
